Drummer Bernard “Pretty” Purdie was born in Elkton, Maryland on June 11, 1939. He is often billed as “the world’s most recorded drummer” and his list of associations include Aretha Franklin, Steely Dan, Dizzy Gillespie and Gato Barbieri. He has toured Europe with the Masters of Groove Trio and produced a video entitled “The Groove Master.”
He was interviewed in West Orange, New Jersey on July 30, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in West Orange, New Jersey filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Bernard Purdie here with me today. Thanks for driving and meeting with me.
